tagline.en: Temporally consistent video depth — the Video Depth Anything prior for stable, flicker-free depth across frames.
tagline.zh: 时序一致的视频深度——Video Depth Anything 先验,让逐帧深度稳定、无闪烁。

en: Video Depth Anything is a depth model from the Depth Anything team, used here as a geometry prior. Where single-image depth estimators tend to flicker frame to frame, this model is designed to produce depth that stays temporally consistent across a whole video.

In WorldFoundry it plugs in as an independent temporal depth prior, exposed through the shared geometry-prior interface. Reconstruction and 4D pipelines (such as VIPE-style profiles) can select it to supply per-frame depth without owning the model code themselves.
You use it as a building block rather than an end-to-end generator: feed it a video, and it returns depth maps that downstream geometry and scene-reconstruction steps can rely on.
zh: Video Depth Anything 是 Depth Anything 团队的深度模型,在这里作为几何先验使用。单张图像的深度估计往往逐帧闪烁,而该模型专为在整段视频上保持时序一致的深度而设计。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它作为一个独立的时序深度先验接入,通过统一的几何先验接口暴露。重建与 4D pipeline(例如 VIPE 类配置)可以选用它来提供逐帧深度,而无需自行维护模型代码。
它是一个构建模块而非端到端生成器:输入一段视频,它返回可供下游几何与场景重建步骤依赖的深度图。

whenToUse.en: Use it when a pipeline needs depth over video that doesn't jitter between frames — for 3D/4D reconstruction, scene geometry, or as a prior feeding other components.
whenToUse.zh: 当某条 pipeline 需要在视频上获得逐帧不抖动的深度时使用它——用于 3D/4D 重建、场景几何,或作为喂给其他组件的先验。

notFor.en: Not a video or image generator — it estimates depth, and requires its checkpoint to be available before it can run.
notFor.zh: 它不是视频或图像生成器——它做的是深度估计,且需要先备好其 checkpoint 才能运行。

en: Temporally consistent depth across an entire video
From the Depth Anything team's model lineage
Drops into the shared geometry-prior interface as a reusable component
zh: 整段视频上时序一致的深度
出自 Depth Anything 团队的模型脉络
作为可复用组件接入统一的几何先验接口
